simple.summary: אֲחַסְבַּי (ʼĂchaçbay) means Achasbai , an Israelite First listed occurrence: 2Sam 23 34.

definitions.full: H308. Achasbay אֲחַסְבַּי proper name, masculine father of Eliphelet, one of David's heroes 2Sam 23:34 . (Meaning dubious; 1Chr 11:35 has אוּר׃ , followed by חֵפֶר ; text. probably corrupt.)
